gaps: Target test environment (host/owner) and authorization boundary are not defined in the repository; docker/README.md only documents a local/self-hosted Compose deployment.
Effective deployed version is not pinned: docker/docker-compose.yml builds image octop:latest with no version tag or digest for effective-version verification.
Rollback target, trigger conditions and owner are not documented; only 'docker compose down' / 'up -d --build' appear in docker/README.md, with no previous-version artifact.

Credential acquisition for OCTOP_DEFAULT_PASSWORD / OCTOP_ADMIN_USERNAME / OPENAI_API_KEY / DASHSCOPE_API_KEY is not specified (env var names only; docker/README.md, docker/docker-compose.yml, docs/configuration.md).
No dedicated post-deploy IT environment is configured: tests/integration boot the app in-process via tests/support/app.octop_client and do not exercise the Docker deployment.
No persisted per-case or aggregate report path (JUnit XML / report file) is configured; results only appear in pytest stdout and the GitHub Actions job log (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
Live/external-service credentials (LIVE_* secrets in .github/workflows/ci.yml) and OCTOP_TEST_DATABASE_URL for the postgresql marker are outside the local runner; access/ownership is not defined.
